name: Avoid apixaban with phenytoin
actions: Avoid concomitant apixaban and phenytoin as directed in the apixaban label.

rationale: The apixaban label lists phenytoin among combined P-gp and strong CYP3A4 inducers that reduce apixaban exposure.

explanation_template: Phenytoin can lower apixaban exposure through combined CYP3A4 and P-gp induction. The apixaban label says to avoid this combination.

references.citation: Avoid apixaban with combined P-gp and strong CYP3A4 inducers, including phenytoin.
